summary: Diego Gutierrez Caraveo, 26, drowned while paddleboarding at Rifle Gap Reservoir; not wearing a personal flotation device or a leash and had reportedly consumed substances prior to recreating; fatality reported via the Garfield County coroner.
notes: Occurrence date Sunday 2024-05-12 (weekday-verified; Sopris Sun Scuttlebutt issue ~May 22/23, 2024 cites 'May 12'). Coroner-reported paddleboarding drowning companion case to the 2024-05-18 Harvey Gap drowning (id 2752).
